basic_info.description: Welcome to 8 Buchanan Street, Residence 505.  This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium is located at the prestigious Linea San Francisco, designed by renowned architect Bernardo Fort-Brescia.  With appx. 1,025 sq.ft. and dramatic views from every room, this property is the ideal city home.    The chef's kitchen boasts a custom island with European cabinetry, quartz countertops, stone backsplash, and premium gas appliances. Wide-plank wood flooring flows throughout the spacious living and dining areas, creating warmth and sophistication. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet, spa-like bath, and in-unit laundry for added convenience.  Enjoy top-tier amenities including an assigned parking space, lobby attendant, elevator, bike storage, intercom system, and a shared rooftop deck with panoramic city views. A serene interior courtyard provides a peaceful retreat right at home.  Located at the vibrant crossroads of Hayes Valley, Duboce Triangle, the Castro, and Mission Dolores, you're steps from MUNI, Whole Foods, Safeway, Starbucks, Pet Food Express, and more. With a near-perfect 99 Walk Score, this penthouse is the ideal blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience.
